{{Quote|Though Vaiken was lost all those centuries ago, his plan and his name lived on to inspire countless generations who marched under the Imperial banner.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 11" />}}
'''Odile Vaiken''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] and its aftermath. Vaiken grew up within the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|borders]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|original Sith Empire]] and was, like other citizens, a loyal servant of his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|overlords]]. The Great Hyperspace War between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] ended badly for the Sith, and their subjects were forced to flee their homes to escape retribution from enemy forces. The young Vaiken joined his fellow countrymen in a massive exodus from their decimated [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], led by a [[Tenebrae|reclusive Sith Lord]]. After wandering the [[Star/Legends|stars]] for twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the migrant [[Exile fleet|fleet]] that carried the Sith expatriates happened upon [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], a forgotten Sith colony [[Planet/Legends|world]].

After the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] leading the exodus chose Dromund Kaas to be their new [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and proclaimed himself the new [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of his people, Vaiken dedicated himself to helping build the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|new Imperial society]]. Vaiken was instrumental in establishing order among the Empire's non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] subjects through the creation of the new [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]], which comprised an expertly-trained [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|army]] and a technologically advanced [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|navy]]. Vaiken's contributions to the ascendant government earned him the recognition of the Emperor and the governing [[Dark Council]], who named him the first [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the Empire. Vaiken was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a [[Odile Vaiken's final campaign|campaign]] to defeat an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]], but his military legacy remained intact for over a millennium.

==Biography==
===Exiled===
{{Quote|The Emperor's role in the reconstruction was as visionary alone. He's said to have withdrawn into isolation and left the logistics to the newly formed Dark Council&hellip; and to loyal Imperial leaders like Odile Vaiken.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 11" />}}
Odile Vaiken was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived within the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|borders]] of the original [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]<ref name="Timeline 11" /> at the latter end of the [[Golden Age of the Sith]].<ref name="GAotS exp">Odile Vaiken is stated to have lived during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in ''[[Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire]]'', which coincided with the final year of the [[Golden Age of the Sith]], as established in ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]'' and [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire|''Tales of the Jedi: The Fall of the Sith Empire'']].</ref> Vaiken's childhood was spent amongst other Humans as well as members of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]], all of whom lived in service of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], the Empire's religious and [[Politics/Legends|political]] leaders.<ref name="Timeline 11" /> In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], a struggle for control of the Empire between [[Lord/Legends|Lords]] [[Ludo Kressh]] and [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] broke out, ultimately resulting in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] first contact with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and a [[The galaxy/Legends|pan-galactic]] conflict known as the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The war eventually reached the Sith [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], where the Empire was [[Second battle of Korriban|defeated]] by the Republic and its subjects were forced to flee retribution from enemy forces.<ref name="Timeline 11" />

[[File:Vaiken_exodus.jpg|thumb|left|280px|A young Odile Vaiken studies ship controls aboard a vessel of the Exile fleet.]]
The young Vaiken was on Korriban at the end of the war but was able to escape the Republic's decimation of the world by joining hundreds of his countrymen in a massive exodus from the crumbling Sith Empire. The operation, headed by [[Tenebrae|one]] of the few surviving [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords]], was a last-ditch effort to preserve what was left of Imperial culture. Aboard eight [[Sith dreadnaught|transports]], the surviving Sith fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], leaving their homes behind.<ref name="Timeline 11" /> For twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] thereafter, this [[Exile fleet|fleet]] wandered deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in search of a new home from which they could rebuild their society.<ref name="Dromund Kaas">{{Holonet|planets|dromund-kaas|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> During this [[Time/Legends|time]], Vaiken learned [[Astrogation/Legends|navigation]] techniques from the [[Helm officer/Legends|helmsmen]] of the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] vessels and became one of his people's most respected [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. He was a valued member of the Imperial hierarchy by [[4980 BBY]], at which point the Exile [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] discovered [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]<ref name="Timeline 11" />&mdash;a former Sith colony world that had been lost to history since its original discovery by the now-defunct Empire.<ref name="Dromund Kaas" /> The wild jungle planet was chosen to be the new capital for the Imperial expatriates, on which they would build a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|new Empire]] and begin plans to take revenge on the Republic.<ref name="Timeline 11" />

While the Dark Lord who led the fleet to Dromund Kaas took his place as [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], he chose not to take a hands-on approach to the creation of his new Imperial dominion. Instead, he retreated into seclusion and left the day-to-day affairs of his people to the newly formed [[Dark Council]] of Sith Lords and to a number of capable non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]], among whom ranked Odile Vaiken. The man was tasked with bringing order to the non-Sith members of the Empire and with the creation of a new [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] that could one day not only rival, but also defeat, the [[Republic Military/Legends|armed forces]] of the Galactic Republic.<ref name="Timeline 11" />

===Military innovator===
{{Quote|Vaiken knew he would never see even a fraction of his plan's success. Nonetheless, he garnered the support of the Dark Council and started the work.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 11" />}}
[[File:Vaiken_recruits.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Grand Moff Vaiken gives an ardent speech to the hardened soldiers of the new Imperial military.]]
The most integral part of his plan to recreate a robust Sith Empire was the building of a strong army. To that end, Vaiken took his mandate from the Dark Council and began to recruit every non&ndash;[[The Force/Legends|Force]]-user of proper age into the new [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]]. In addition, he developed a [[Imperial Military training regimen|rigorous training regimen]] that brought his conscripts to the highest standards of military discipline. With his well-trained forces in tow, Vaiken began his [[Dromund Kaas wilderness campaign|first combat operation]]&mdash;clearing a region of the Dromund Kaas wilderness to make way for the new Imperial center of government, [[Kaas City]]. [[Imperial records|Records]] kept by the Sith Empire would later indicate that Vaiken himself [[Death/Legends|slew]] a rabid [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] on the site where the capital building known as the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]] was built.<ref name="Timeline 11" /> Given the fearsome reputation of these beasts&mdash;terentateks were known to kill multiple Force-sensitives single-handedly<ref name="Terentatek">{{HolonetOld|inhabitants|terentatek|Terentatek}}</ref>&mdash;this feat spoke well of Vaiken's abilities in battle, and lent to the reputation he himself was accruing.<ref name="Timeline 11" />

With the Sith's domination over Dromund Kaas complete, Vaiken began to lay the blueprints for what would prove to be his most ambitious goal: the establishment of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Armada]]. He understood that the job of creating a navy as powerful as he imagined would take centuries and accepted the fact that he would never live to see it even partially completed. Regardless, he gained the support of the Dark Council and began to execute his plan. Vaiken dedicated the entirety of his army to the task, assigning them to either [[Mining/Legends|mine]] for resources, [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] the [[Starship/Legends|vessels]], or manufacture the final products.<ref name="Timeline 11" />

He was alive to see the production of the first of his newly-designed [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], and his success earned him recognition from the Sith Emperor himself: Vaiken was the first [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the Imperial Military to earn the honorary title of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]]. He continued to serve the Empire dutifully for a period of time, and even participated in early campaigns to conquer [[Alien/Legends|alien]] societies surrounding Dromund Kaas. Grand Moff Vaiken was killed during [[Odile Vaiken's final campaign|one such mission]], dying aboard the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|prototype Star Destroyer]]<ref name="Timeline 11" /> around [[4904 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline 11 date" />

===Legacy===
====March to war====
{{Quote|The Imperial military is unrivaled. When we march to war, vengeance will be ours.|Grand Moff Odile Vaiken|<ref name="Encyclopedia" />}}
[[File:Bioware_bellator.png|thumb|left|250px|Vaiken's Star Destroyers composed the bulk of the Imperial Military.]]
Even after Odile Vaiken's death, the Empire continued to expand and strengthen, due in large part to his visionary organization of the Imperial Military. He was fondly remembered throughout the Empire, and the efforts he put into establishing a strong army and navy inspired Sith military officers and infantry for centuries.<ref name="Timeline 11" /> [[Vaiken's Torch]], an eternally-burning flame, was lit in the jungles of Dromund Kaas as a representation of the Empire's undying dedication to their revenge on the Republic.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The fruits of his labor were realized nearly [[3681 BBY|1,220 years after]] his death,<ref name="GGW date">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire}} is dated at 1,251 BTC, which is 1,223 years prior to the [[Great Galactic War]]. This was found using the date for the war provided by ''[[Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire]]'' and simple math.</ref> when the then-massive Imperial Military struck out from the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and invaded the Republic in a [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] and brutal conflict known as the [[Great Galactic War]]. The Sith Empire was victorious in the war, finally achieving vengeance after the defeat in the Great Hyperspace War.<ref name="SithEmpire">{{Holonet|allegiances|sith-empire|The Sith Empire}}</ref> The title of Grand Moff was still in use during this time, held by several individuals, including [[Rycus Kilran]] and [[Zellos]].<ref name="RycusKilran">{{HolonetOld|biographies|grand-moff-kilran|Grand Moff Kilran}}</ref><ref name="Timeline 5">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui|int=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui}}</ref> During the following [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|period of political unrest]], the Imperial Military utilized a [[Imperial fleet staging area|naval staging area]] that housed a massive [[Space station/Legends|space station]] named in honor of the late Grand Moff&mdash;the [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> Some individuals in the Empire believed that the Empire's primary intelligence-gathering organization, [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], was created on Vaiken's orders, though others believed that it was an offshoot of the [[Sith Emperor's power base|Emperor's own power base]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

====Studies of the Jedi====
{{Quote|In our brief glimpses into the Empire's secret history, one name stands out&mdash;Grand Moff Odile Vaiken&mdash;the founder of the modern Imperial Military.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 11" />}}
In an effort to research the roots of the Great Galactic War and the reasons behind the Sith's sudden and decisive victory over the Republic,<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] delved into Imperial historical records stolen by [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]].<ref name="Timeline 11 article">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20101210|text=Rebirth of the Sith Empire|nolive=1}}</ref> He found that one name stood out among the non-Force-using Imperials who helped to rebuild Sith society&mdash;that of Odile Vaiken. The Grand Moff was the focus of a [[Holodocumentary|holorecord]] compiled by Dural following the end of the Great Galactic War.<ref name="Timeline 11" /> This record was submitted to the [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|Jedi Archives]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="Timeline 1" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Vaiken's story represents the surprising loyalty the Imperial citizens show to an Empire in which they will always be subservient to the Sith.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 11" />}}
[[File:TOR_Timeline011.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Odile Vaiken is honored as the first Grand Moff of the Sith Empire.]]
Odile Vaiken was among the most influential individuals in the reformation of the Sith Empire. The Grand Moff was a capable military leader and logistics director, and demonstrated these skills in the planning of the new Imperial Military. These characteristics, as well as his talent as a pilot, gained him the notice of the Emperor and the Dark Council, who granted him the responsibility of bringing order to the non-Sith citizenry. He was highly successful, and his visionary projects survived his death and more than a millennium of Imperial expansion. His memory served as an inspiration for generations of Imperial servicemen and women, which eventually allowed the Empire to overcome the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Timeline 11" />

According to [[Jedi historian|Jedi Historian]] Gnost-Dural, the most notable aspect of Vaiken's achievements was that they were accomplished by a man who was entirely loyal to an Empire in which he would always live as a second-class citizen. The Sith power structure placed those who were not sensitive to the Force as servants to the Sith Lords who could touch the energy field,<ref name="Timeline 11" /> leaving many of the non-Force-users feeling disenfranchised.<ref name="Fatal Alliance">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref> Vaiken was able to organize the Force-deaf into a loyal fighting force and engender loyalty to the Emperor and the Dark Council. For this feat, as well as the laying of the groundwork for the Imperial Armada, Vaiken was named the first Grand Moff of the Sith Empire;<ref name="Timeline 11" /> Grand Moff was a title borrowed from the [[Expansionist Period/Legends|era]] of early Republic expansionism,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> which was fitting for the man who allowed for the Empire to begin its own expansionist campaigns.<ref name="Timeline 11" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grand Moff Odile Vaiken was created as part of the backstory for [[LucasArts]]' and [[BioWare]]'s online [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He was introduced through the ''[[Galactic Timeline]]'', a promotional feature found on [[The Holonet]] section of the game's [http://swtor.com website]. Vaiken's debut was in the eleventh entry in the series, titled [[Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire|''Rebirth of the Sith Empire'']]. He was later mentioned in the reference books ''[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.
